summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Linkage Global Inc, a Cayman Islands exempted company, furnishing a notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 8, 2026. The proposed resolutions are a 23-for-1 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, an amendment to authorized share capital, and adoption of amended memorandum and articles. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is involved; this is a routine capital reorganization.
